comparison.objective: Load a press blank and safely cycle the ram; candidate removes four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Blank insertion, workspace clearing, and simultaneous two-button holding versus recessed coaxial tool alignment, hammer impact control, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Blank correctly loaded, grippers clear, both controls held until closure, then released versus four fractures and complete tang containment without damage.
comparison.reason: The press task tests safety interlocking and simultaneous controls, not tool-mediated fracture. No separate spec versions were provided.
